# ListItem
Atlas List Item v1 — a row or card that pairs an optional leading visual with a title, a description and an optional action. 2 directions × 3 variants × 2 sizes (12 total).

When to use: list rows with a leading visual (people, files, links, settings), and vertical media cards. Direction=horizontal is the compact row; Direction=vertical stacks media, text and action, with the media filling the item width at a 3:2 aspect ratio.

Media, title, description and actions can each be hidden. Media takes a List Item Media, an Avatar or an Avatar Group. Actions holds a Button or an icon, or is hidden.

Sizes: md is the default; sm is the dense row.

## Variants
`default` · `outline` · `muted`

`sm` · `md`
